name: Gajendra Shrestha
title: Science of Financial Freedom: 401(k) Retirement Frameworks in America and Abroad
description: A practical financial guide covering 401(k) allocations, employer matching, tax-deferred growth, rollover rules, and global wealth management for expatriates and immigrant professionals.
abstract: This comprehensive lecture breaks down the mechanisms of retirement savings in the United States and abroad. Focus areas include 401(k) compounding math, index fund allocations, employer match capture, backdoor Roth IRA conversions, tax diversification across pre-tax and Roth buckets, and managing international pensions across borders for diaspora scholars and professionals.
speakerBio: Gajendra Shrestha is a financial specialist based in Utah, specializing in wealth preservation, 401(k) optimization, cross-border tax literacy, and financial independence for Nepali professionals in the diaspora.

name: Aakanksha Dhakal
title: Development of Food Packaging Films Using Bacterial Cellulose and Pullulan Impregnated with Green-Synthesized Silver Nanoparticles
description: Formulating bioactive, biodegradable antimicrobial food packaging films leveraging bacterial cellulose matrices, pullulan biopolymers, and green silver nanoparticles for prolonged shelf life.
abstract: The increasing environmental burden of single-use petroleum-based plastics has accelerated the development of biodegradable active packaging. This presentation examines the synthesis and characterization of nanocomposite films prepared from bacterial cellulose and pullulan, integrated with green-synthesized silver nanoparticles. We discuss barrier properties, tensile strength, and antimicrobial efficacy against major foodborne pathogens.

name: Prof. Bishal Sitaula
role: Professor, Norwegian University of Life Sciences
title: Ancient Wisdom Meets Modern Relationship Science: Can Healthy Marriage Become a Source of Healing, Resilience, and Mental Well-Being?
description: Synthesizing ancient Vedic relational philosophy with modern attachment theory and neuroscience to explore how conscious marital partnerships build resilience and mental health.
abstract: Exploring the nexus between classical Eastern relational philosophy and contemporary neurobiology, attachment theory, and positive psychology. This presentation investigates how supportive interpersonal relationships and conscious marriage act as buffers against chronic stress, fostering emotional resilience and holistic mental well-being across life stages.

name: Dr. Bibha Gautam
title: Nursing Perspectives on Metabolic Health and Chronic Disease Management
description: Evidence-based nursing methodologies and proactive community-focused clinical interventions addressing type-2 diabetes, hypertension, and metabolic syndrome.
abstract: An evidence-based overview of advanced nursing protocols and community-centered interventions aimed at early screening, patient empowerment, and lifestyle modification to alleviate the global burden of metabolic syndrome and comorbid cardiovascular diseases.

name: Santosh Thapa
title: Plant Protein Isolation and Eco-Friendly Packaging Films
description: Innovative extraction methodologies for high-purity legume and cereal plant proteins and their cross-linking into biodegradable barrier packaging films.
abstract: This lecture details high-yield extraction and fractionation protocols for non-allergenic plant proteins, examining the relationship between protein secondary structures and physical barrier performance in biodegradable films.

name: Prof. Lekhnath Kafle
role: Professor, National Pingtung University of Science and Technology, Taiwan
title: Research on Bee Biology, Pollination Ecology, and Environmental Health
description: Investigating honeybee colony dynamics, pesticide exposure, pollination ecosystems, and the vital role of bees as bio-indicators of environmental sustainability.
abstract: Honeybees provide invaluable ecological pollination services essential for planetary biodiversity and human food security. This session presents longitudinal research on honeybee behavioral ecology, pesticide sub-lethal toxicity, and the efficacy of using pollinator health as an early warning sensor for broader agro-environmental degradation.

name: Prof. Choodamani Khanal
abstract: Scientific lecture topic and session details are scheduled for confirmation.

name: Prof. Rudra Kafle & Umesh Silwal
title: New Learning Techniques and Artificial Intelligence in STEM Education
description: Integrating generative AI, adaptive learning algorithms, and interactive simulation tools to elevate pedagogical effectiveness in undergraduate physics and science education.
abstract: A collaborative lecture exploring how modern large language models, intelligent tutoring algorithms, and real-time visualization frameworks can be responsibly embedded into physics, engineering, and mathematics curricula to enhance student mastery and collaborative inquiry.

name: Sandeep Paudel
title: Degradable Plastics: Bio-Based Polymers for Sustainable Materials
description: Synthesis of biodegradable aliphatic polyesters and starch-blended polymers to replace petroleum plastics and eliminate persistent microplastic pollution.
abstract: Investigating polymerization mechanisms, degradation kinetics in compost and aquatic environments, and material durability tradeoffs of novel bio-based polymer blends.

name: Prof. Gopal Bhatta
role: Professor of Astrophysics, University of Zielona Góra, Poland
title: Black Holes & High-Energy Astrophysics
description: Theoretical and observational physics of supermassive black holes, event horizon imaging, accretion discs, and relativistic plasma jets in active galactic nuclei.
abstract: Highlighting multi-wavelength observations of active galactic nuclei (AGN), accretion disc instabilities, and relativistic jet kinematics powered by supermassive black hole central engines.

name: Dr. Gyan Nyaupane
title: One Heritage, Multiple Meanings: History, Challenges, and Prospects of Lumbini, Nepal
description: A multi-layered socio-cultural, religious, and geographic study of Lumbini, dissecting tourism development, spiritual heritage preservation, and indigenous community inclusion.
abstract: Analyzing Lumbini through critical heritage lenses, this study contrasts international Buddhist pilgrimage aspirations with local agrarian livelihood priorities, presenting policy frameworks for equitable cultural preservation.

name: Bishal Adhikari
title: Food Manufacturing Certificate in USA: Standards, Compliance & Careers
description: Navigating US food manufacturing regulations, SQF/BRC/HACCP certifications, audit readiness, and career advancement in industrial food processing.
abstract: A roadmap for food scientists and quality engineers seeking compliance mastery in SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000, and FDA PCQI certifications within US food manufacturing facilities.

name: Pratibha Sharma
title: Immunology: Molecular Pathways and Vaccine Defense Mechanisms
description: Insights into cellular immunology, antigen presentation, memory T-cell responses, and translational avenues for therapeutic vaccine design.
abstract: Reviewing molecular checkpoints in antigen processing, humoral vs. cell-mediated response coordination, and next-generation adjuvant formulations for infectious disease prevention.

name: Prof. Umesh Silwal
title: Nuclear Fusion: Green Energy for the Next Generation
description: Plasma confinement, magnetic fusion reactors (tokamaks and stellarators), and engineering milestones toward infinite, clean fusion energy for the next generation.
abstract: Examines magnetic confinement fusion physics, high-temperature superconducting magnets, and recent Q>1 plasma energy milestones charting the commercial pathway toward unlimited zero-carbon energy.

name: Pragyan Adhikari
role: South Dakota State University / Vice President, GNSC
title: Environmental and Health: Urban Exposures and Public Health in Boston
description: Field studies on urban environmental health dynamics, particulate matter dispersion, and community-level mitigation strategies.
abstract: Quantifying spatial correlations between urban micro-climates, particulate matter (PM2.5) concentrations, and pediatric respiratory hospital admissions across metropolitan areas.

name: Dr. Ankit Aryal
title: Environmental and Health: Interdisciplinary Perspectives from LSU
description: Investigating environmental toxicology, airborne pollutants, water contaminants, and their correlated epidemiological health outcomes.
abstract: Evaluating watershed contaminant transport, toxicological biomarkers, and longitudinal environmental epidemiological frameworks established at Louisiana State University.

name: Dr. Prakash Shrestha
title: Good and Bad Sides of Antibiotics
description: A clinical exploration of therapeutic antibiotic efficacy, the impending antimicrobial resistance (AMR) global crisis, and responsible prescription stewardship.
abstract: A clinical discussion on targeted antibiotic therapy, microbiome collateral damage, horizontal gene transfer in hospital pathogens, and physician-led antimicrobial stewardship.

name: Beda N Dahal
title: Power of Food Antioxidants for Prevention of Inflammatory Diseases
description: Mechanistic actions of dietary flavonoids, polyphenols, and bioactive antioxidants in downregulating inflammatory biomarkers and preventing chronic degenerative diseases.
abstract: Investigating nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) pathway upregulation by dietary polyphenols, reducing cellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) and mitigating chronic vascular inflammation.

name: Mr. Abhikesh Khadka
title: Microplastics in Food and Health Consequences
description: Tracking environmental trophic transfer of micro- and nano-plastics, digestive uptake mechanisms, and their endocrine and inflammatory impacts on human health.
abstract: Synthesizing global detection data on microplastics in commercial seafood, drinking water, and salts, examining gastrointestinal epithelial translocation and systemic cytotoxicity.

name: Dr. Yakindra Timilsena
role: Senior Research Fellow, Australia / Member, GNSC
title: Scientific Innovations: Plant-Based Omega-3 Emerging Trends
description: Emerging lipid technologies, microalgae harvesting, and microencapsulation matrices to stabilize and deliver bioavailable plant-derived omega-3 fatty acids.
abstract: Exploring novel spray-drying and complex coacervation encapsulation matrices that protect oxidatively sensitive plant-based ALA and EPA/DHA lipids without synthetic preservatives.

name: Dr. Manish Thapalia
title: Food-Borne Parasites: Detection, Pathogenesis, and Public Health Controls
description: Epidemiological overview of emerging foodborne parasitic infections, diagnostic surveillance methods, and biosecurity interventions across modern food distribution networks.
abstract: Covers diagnostic PCR assays, life cycle stages of Cyclospora, Cryptosporidium, and Giardia in fresh agricultural produce, and sanitary hurdle technologies.

name: Ms. Sarika Gupta
title: Building a Strong Food Safety Culture: Beyond Compliance
description: Transforming food safety from a baseline regulatory compliance checklist into an intrinsic operational culture with systemic accountability across leadership and line teams.
abstract: Organizational behavioral psychology applied to commercial food manufacturing: building psychological safety, near-miss reporting habits, and cross-functional quality ownership.

name: Dr. Achyut Mishra
title: Revolutionizing Innovation in Plant-Based Vegan Cheese: The Latest in Product Development
description: Recent product breakthroughs in structuring plant proteins, lipid phase emulation, and microbial fermentation to achieve authentic dairy cheese melt and sensory parity.
abstract: Details the biochemistry of plant protein cross-linking, enzymatic starch degradation, and fermentation-driven flavor synthesis required to emulate cheddar and mozzarella casein networks.

name: Mr. Krishna GC
title: Obesity Food Base Management
description: Nutritional biochemistry and food-based intervention protocols designed for metabolic management, satiety regulation, and obesity prevention.
abstract: Examines dietary fiber viscous gel formation, gut peptide (GLP-1, PYY) stimulation, and practical dietary structuring for long-term glycemic control.

name: Dr. Namrata Karki Kandel
title: Innovation in Wellness: Development of Dietary Supplements from Ideation to Commercialization
description: End-to-end framework for formulation, stability testing, clinical validation, regulatory approval, and scalable manufacturing of novel health and wellness supplements.
abstract: A comprehensive journey through botanical ingredient standardization, cGMP manufacturing, accelerated stability modeling, and US DSHEA regulatory filing.

name: Dr. Ram Raj Panthi
title: Dynamics of Casein Micelles: A Techno-Functional Perspective
description: Understanding casein micelle structures, techno-functional properties, and molecular interactions to optimize cheese moisture control and high-protein dairy powder rehydration.
abstract: A better understanding of casein micelles properties and their interactions has led to greater opportunities for improving industrial dairy processes. This presentation highlights casein micelle surface potentials, colloidal calcium phosphate equilibria, and how their interactions can be modulated for moisture control in cheese making and milk protein concentrate rehydration kinetics.
speakerBio: Dr. Ram Raj Panthi has gained deep research expertise in cheese and dairy powder science. He has co-authored 12 research papers, book chapters, and review articles. He holds a PhD from University College Cork/Teagasc Food Research Centre, Ireland, and currently serves as Cheese Technical Lead at Dairygold in Ireland.

name: Dr. Bikram Upadhyaya
title: The Functional Interplay between Bioactive Peptides, Gut Microbiota, and Obesity
description: Investigating the metabolic bioavailability of bioactive pulse peptides (g-EV) in diabetic obese animal models, demonstrating hepatic AMPK activation and beneficial gut flora modulation.
abstract: Obesity, diabetes, and related metabolic complications continue to be major global public health concerns with few effective nutritional treatment options. Our study investigated the bioavailability and metabolic effects of gamma-glutamyl valine (g-EV), a dipeptide found in dry edible beans, in a diabetic obese mouse model (db/db mice). Lower blood glucose, reduced polyuria, and upregulation of hepatic AMPK activity illustrated g-EV's anti-diabetic potential, alongside favorable modulation of the probiotic Akkermansia population.
speakerBio: Dr. Bikram Upadhyaya is a research scientist at Eurofins with over 5 years of experience in upstream and downstream process development in biochemical engineering and protein biochemistry, scale-up principles, and biopharmaceutical cGMP manufacturing. He earned his Master's Degree in Biomedical Engineering and holds a B.Tech in Food Technology from Tribhuvan University.

name: Mr. Arjun Ghimire
title: Dynamic Complementary Strategies in Solid-State Microwave Processing
description: Evaluating solid-state microwave systems, real-time thermal camera feedback, and machine-learning-driven adaptive phase control for smart, energy-efficient food processing.
abstract: Solid-state microwave systems offer consistent, controllable volumetric heating results where thermal contributions depend on frequency, relative phase, and cavity cavity loads. Integrating thermal imaging cameras enables real-time monitoring of heating uniformity, while intelligent closed-loop control dynamically tunes microwave parameters for industrial applications.

name: Dr. Rudra Kafle
role: Associate Professor of Physics / Vice President, GNSC
title: Atomic Clocks for Accurate Timekeeping
description: A comprehensive study of quantum atomic transitions, laser cooling, optical lattice frequency standards, and ultra-precise timekeeping essential for GPS and satellite navigation.
abstract: Presents atomic physics principles underpinning modern optical lattice clocks and caesium fountains, analyzing frequency uncertainties below 10^-18 and their mission-critical role in relativistic geodesy and satellite navigation.

name: Mr. Suvash Kafle
role: Vice President of Dairy, Perfect Day Foods
title: Precision Fermentation: Pioneering Food Security and Sustainable Nutrition
description: Showcasing industrial precision fermentation, cellular agriculture, and scalable sustainable protein production to revolutionize global nutrition while slashing resource footprints.
abstract: Embark on a groundbreaking journey into precision fermentation, where biotechnology converges with food security. Initially recognized for pharmaceutical insulin and enzyme production, precision fermentation has transcended boundaries to revolutionize dairy proteins, achieving radical reductions in land, water, and greenhouse gas footprints without animal agriculture.
speakerBio: Suvash Kafley is Vice President of Dairy at Perfect Day Foods. With over a decade of leadership in food innovation, he previously held senior positions at Milk Specialties Global. He holds an EMBA from the University of St. Thomas, an MS in Food Science and Nutrition from UW-Stout, and a B.Tech from Tribhuvan University.

name: Dr. Buddhi P. Lamsal
role: Professor of Food Processing, Iowa State University
title: Processing of Foods: A Necessary Evil or Opportunity to Add / Create Value?
description: Investigating thermal and non-thermal food processing techniques, protein functionalization, pathogen control, and consumer perceptions surrounding ultra-processed foods.
abstract: If we are what we eat, foods are what they are made of. Processing of food after harvest mostly renders them safer against pathogens while extending shelf life by inactivating degrading enzymes. Processing into constituent components provides opportunities to formulate nutritious, convenient, and appealing food products. This discussion evaluates the balance between food processing benefits and concerns over ultra-processed foods.
speakerBio: Dr. Buddhi P. Lamsal is a Professor of Food Processing at Iowa State University, Ames, USA and a certified Agricultural Engineer. With 20+ years of plant protein research, he has published over 100 peer-reviewed articles and co-edited 3 books. He is an active member of scientific societies AOCS and IFT.

name: Dr. Gopi Upreti
title: ECOSOCIOCENTRISM: The Earth First Paradigm — A Journey from Anthropocene to Symbiocene
description: A deep philosophical and ecological examination of ecosociocentrism, critiquing anthropocentric exploitation and charting a roadmap toward harmonious ecological coexistence.
abstract: Critiquing human-induced ecological overshoot, this session articulates the theoretical foundations of Ecosociocentrism, advocating for symbiotic human-planetary co-existence across policy, technology, and ethics.

name: Dr. Parshuram Dahal
title: Shaping the Future: Bridging Diverse Domains and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for World Changing Innovations
description: Exploring interdisciplinary integration of cutting-edge AI architectures, foundation models, and domain knowledge to drive breakthrough scientific and technological innovations.
abstract: A strategic overview of machine learning application across genomics, materials discovery, and industrial automation, examining cross-domain transfer learning paradigms.

name: Dr. Chandra Giri
role: Senior Advisor, U.S. EPA & Duke University
title: Monitoring of the World using Earth Observation Satellite Data
description: Highlighting multi-decadal satellite remote sensing frameworks, global land cover mapping, mangrove ecosystem tracking, and environmental monitoring systems.
abstract: Reviewing decades of Landsat and Sentinel earth observation data, this talk presents planetary-scale spatial analysis for mangrove conservation, forest cover dynamics, and climate resilience monitoring.

name: Dr. Madhab Pandey
title: A Revolution in DNA Sequencing Technology: Application in Human Health, Agriculture & Biodiversity Conservation
description: Examining rapid advancements in high-throughput DNA sequencing platforms and their transformative applications across clinical health, agricultural genomics, and biodiversity conservation.
abstract: From Sanger sequencing to single-molecule long-read sequencers: evaluating cost reductions, error rates, and clinical diagnostic power in personalized oncology and pathogen tracing.

name: Dr. Achyut Adhikari
title: Food Safety Modernization Act: Revolutionizing Food Safety Regulations
description: An overview of the Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) and its impact on food safety regulations, compliance standards, and risk prevention across agricultural and processing sectors.
abstract: FSMA represents the largest reform of US food safety laws in over 70 years, shifting regulatory focus from reactive response to preventive hazard control. This session dissects agricultural water rules, preventive controls for human food, and compliance implementation across growers and packers.
